active_tasks.summary: SCUE: M3 Cue Stream — ON HOLD per user preference. Unblocked technically (FE screens + research done) but deferred.

SCUE: M7 Event Detection — spec drafted, awaiting operator approval before implementation. 8 phases: framework, features, heuristic drums, risers/fallers, stabs, storage, RF classifier, training pipeline
Tinyshop: Designer session for UI tasks (TASK-011, 012, 013, 019) — App Shell, Dashboard, Launch Drawer, Welcome Screen
Tinyshop: Phase 1 Foundation — TASK-001 (scaffold), TASK-002 (types), TASK-003 (SQLite) — no designer dependency
Tinyshop: Phase 2 Backend — TASK-004 through TASK-010 (Artifact Engine, SSE, APIs, scanner)
Tinyshop: Phase 3 Frontend — TASK-011 through TASK-023 (UI components, launch flow, edge cases)
Review-cycle skill: encode the three-lens process, session selection, batching, and synthesis as a reusable skill in skills/review-cycle/SKILL.md
Edit() hygiene rule: add guidance to all 3 flow skills — if >3 sequential Edit() on same file, use Write() instead. Reduces edit-cycling anti-pattern (8/25 sessions).
Session scope guideline: add to all 3 flow skills — cap sessions at 1-2 objectives. Sessions with 4+ objectives consistently score 2-3/5 efficiency.
Phase handoff prompt template: formalize the handoff-prompt pattern (emergent in sessions 4,8,14) as a template in templates/phase-handoff.md
Task risk classifier: add risk field (low/medium/high) to tasks.jsonl schema, PreToolUse hook blocks high-risk edits without approved plan. From human-oversight research.
Blast radius scope check: PreToolUse hook cross-references Edit/Write paths against active task's section contract, blocks out-of-scope mutations. From human-oversight research.

Compound error budget: extend fix-attempt-tracker to count total tool calls per phase, checkpoint with operator when budget exhausted (7 steps medium-risk, 4 high-risk). From human-oversight research.
Pre-flight readiness checks: add mandatory checklist to flow skills — acceptance criteria, section assignment, risk level, baseline test run, no conflicting tasks. From human-oversight research.
Interrupt budget tracking: track AskUserQuestion calls and escalations in state snapshot, surface count in session summary. Observability first, caps later. From human-oversight research.
PR size guardrail: convention eval warns when commits exceed 200 LOC net changes, guidance in feature-flow to split at phase boundaries. From human-oversight research.
Trust calibration metrics: extend run record schema with operator_interventions, agent_escalations, auto_approved_phases, rework_count. Feed into assess.py trends. From human-oversight research.
